modules.switch: PRIMA_ORG_LINKS=true, set only after the install and a clean GET /api/health/org-links
uses: prima.hr_it_requests (base; read by org_joining_state as owner)
modules.definer: Owner-run checks (yes/no or one word, never rows): org_event_matches_audit, org_task_matches_event, org_notice_matches_task, org_finance_team and org_run_by (the office running a company, or null) callable by prima_app; org_is_this_transactions_audit, org_desk_people (receiver ids) and org_joining_state (ready/waiting/cancelled/missing) internal; the org_task_guard trigger runs as owner to ask org_joining_state. Four plain catalogue checks generated from core constants, org_flow_starts, org_flow_target_ok and org_flow_to_keyer (ORG_FLOWS) and org_central_employer (isCentralEmployer), internal.
modules.rollback: Set PRIMA_ORG_LINKS=false (the API stops writing hand-overs). Keep the tables: hand-overs and import receipts are records and are never deleted.
